places-pilgrimage-routes-kumano-sankeimi.story: From Kumano it runs 412 km to Kumano; allow about 7 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Kumano Sanzan - Nachi Primeval Forest, Pilgrimage Routes - Kumano Sankeimichi - N, Pilgrimage Routes - Kôya Sankeimichi and Nisanzai Kofun. The line favours views over speed.
